note: Curated tiles for /gta-vi/facts (facts + launch predictions) and /gta-vi/economy (money predictions). Each tile id is the primary predictions.json or october-confirmations.json id; `from` lists every source id the tile replaces, so old #anchors redirect here. Limits: title <= 40 chars, headline <= 18, line <= 70, basis <= 2 sentences, image required.

facts.title: No GTA Online at launch
facts.headline: Story first
facts.line: Online follows later; no date yet.
facts.basis: Rockstar's pre-order announcement describes GTA VI as a single-player experience. GTA Online arrived two weeks after GTA V in 2013; this time no date has been given.

facts.title: In-game purchases, optional
facts.headline: Optional
facts.line: On the age rating; we expect upgrades, not GTA$.
facts.basis: Rockstar's rating line lists in-game purchases, and PEGI's report said the game is playable without them. With no Online at launch, we expect edition upgrades and add-on packs rather than GTA$ cards.
facts.source: Rockstar rating line · PEGI (via Rockstar Intel, Oct 2 2026)

facts.title: An 80-hour story in chapters
facts.headline: 80 hrs
facts.line: RDR2-style chapters; your choices add up.
facts.basis: Rob Nelson put the campaign at about 80 hours, roughly three times GTA V's story. Previews confirm RDR2-style chapters where small choices accumulate.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: The story can require raised cash
facts.headline: Cash-gated
facts.line: Some story steps may need a target sum.
facts.basis: IGN's Rockstar North preview reports that players may need to raise a set amount before some story beats. Stolen cars, store robberies and bank jobs are the named cash sources.

facts.title: Robberies: speed or full take
facts.headline: Fast or full
facts.line: Blow the safe fast and lose valuables, or take your time.
facts.basis: Blowing a safe is quick but damages some of the take; cracking the combination recovers more while police close in. Stolen goods go to specialised fences.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: Steal cars with the WAINK app
facts.headline: Scan first
facts.line: The app prices a car before you take it.
facts.basis: The WAINK phone app shows a parked car's market value, lock, alarm and tracker before you steal it. Damage lowers the sale price.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: Hunting pays
facts.headline: Pelts = cash
facts.line: Wildlife is a new income source.
facts.basis: The Extended Look shows hunting alongside fishing and scuba in Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga. Pelt prices are not official; our payouts are modelled on RDR2.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: A criminal profile, not a morality meter
facts.headline: Pro vs sloppy
facts.line: How you commit crimes shapes reactions — and maybe prices.
facts.basis: A hidden meter tracks professional versus reckless crime and changes story outcomes and how people react. RDR2's honour moved shop prices by up to 25%; Rockstar hasn't said GTA VI does the same.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: Life outside the story
facts.headline: 18+ activities
facts.line: From scuba diving onwards, all optional.
facts.basis: The Extended Look shows scuba, fishing, kayaking, base jumping, racing and more. IGN adds mini golf, a zoo and Ryde Me ride-hailing.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: Jason & Lucia share a life
facts.headline: Together
facts.line: Shop and work together; text or call anytime.
facts.basis: Shared activities deepen the relationship and reveal both backstories. You can text or call the other protagonist at any time; ignoring them hurts a little.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look · IGN hands-on, Oct 7 2026

facts.title: Bodies change over time
facts.headline: Body sim
facts.line: Food, exercise and sleep change you.
facts.basis: Exercise builds muscle, food changes weight and long nights show on faces. Bloomberg reports that sweat scales with exertion.
facts.source: IGN preview, Aug 2026 · Bloomberg (via Rockstar Intel), Oct 14 2026

facts.title: Six-star wanted level
facts.headline: 6 stars
facts.basis: Previews describe a witness-based wanted system carried over from RDR2. The six-star tier itself rests on community reports rather than footage.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + community reports

facts.title: Carry limits, trunk storage
facts.headline: Trunk
facts.line: Spare weapons live in the car.
facts.basis: IGN confirms car trunks hold weapons and spare outfits, like the horse in RDR2. A hard on-foot carry limit is not confirmed.

facts.title: Unplanned encounters
facts.headline: Greet or provoke
facts.basis: In IGN's demo a man in a dumpster asks Lucia for pills and later returns with legal advice. Greet, taunt, defuse and provoke prompts shape how people respond.

facts.title: Leonida map
facts.headline: ~160–170 km²
facts.line: Vice City plus the wider state.
facts.basis: Rob Nelson says Leonida is about twice GTA V's map and three times RDR2's. GTA V is about 81 km²; Rockstar has published no official figure.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: Slow-mo aim and threat view
facts.headline: Bullet time
facts.basis: Jason slows time while aiming, with kill or incapacitate points marked on enemies. A Focus mode highlights useful objects and opportunities.
facts.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview, Aug 27 2026

facts.title: Living crowds
facts.headline: 600k+ animations
facts.line: A dedicated team writes pedestrian dialogue.
facts.basis: GTA VI has over 600,000 NPC animations, against about 55,000 in GTA V. A new LA team writes nothing but pedestrian dialogue.
facts.source: Rockstar preview coverage, Aug 2026 · LOVE magazine issue 27

facts.title: A political, online world
facts.headline: Satire
facts.line: Elections, robocalls, talk radio, a social feed.
facts.basis: Narrative lead Rupert Humphries describes election signs, campaign robocalls and political talk radio. You can browse an in-game social feed but not post.
facts.source: LOVE magazine issue 27 · IGN hands-on, Oct 2026

launch_predictions.title: Launch-week sales
launch_predictions.headline: ~25M copies
launch_predictions.basis: Sensor Tower counts 6.45M US digital pre-orders 45 days out, growing about 380k a week. Scaled to all markets, that points to 22–25M before day-one sales.
launch_predictions.source: Sensor Tower (via Rockstar Intel, Oct 21 2026) + GTAVI.AI model

launch_predictions.title: PC version
launch_predictions.headline: Q1 2027
launch_predictions.basis: GamesBeat cites four industry sources; Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version. GTA V took 19 months to reach PC and RDR2 13.

launch_predictions.title: Vehicles at launch
launch_predictions.line: From GTA V's launch count and map size.
launch_predictions.basis: 268 vehicles are already indexed from trailers and community sightings. GTA V launched with 737.

money_predictions.title: Weekly bonus events from day one
money_predictions.headline: Weekly from Day 1
money_predictions.line: Rotating double-money events, as in GTA Online.
money_predictions.basis: Weekly bonuses have been GTA Online's main engagement loop since 2017. Take-Two cites live events as a key monetisation driver.

money_predictions.title: First payout nerf
money_predictions.headline: Nerf in 6 months
money_predictions.line: Top earners get cut once they hurt Shark Card sales.
money_predictions.basis: GTA Online has nerfed every high-yield activity within 6–18 months since 2015. High yields suppress Shark Card sales.
money_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI economic model · meta-history nerf cadence

money_predictions.title: Endgame cost in Shark Cards
money_predictions.line: Real money to buy the top items in year one.
money_predictions.basis: GTA Online's endgame cost in Shark Cards grew about 23× from 2013 to 2026. GTA VI starts from a reset but has the same incentive to grow the top of the shop.
money_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI economic model · shark-cards endgame projection

money_predictions.title: Megalodon Shark Card price
money_predictions.line: Same sticker as GTA Online since 2013.
money_predictions.basis: The Megalodon card has cost $99.99 since 2013, about $135 in today's money. Take-Two has kept sticker prices flat and inflated through payouts instead.
money_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI economic model · CPI + shark-cards data

money_predictions.title: Best hourly earnings at launch
money_predictions.headline: $3M–5M/hr
money_predictions.line: Up from $250K/hr at GTA Online's 2013 launch.
money_predictions.basis: GTA Online went from about $250K/hr in 2013 to $2M/hr with Cayo Perico in 2020. GTA VI Online starts from a higher floor.
money_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI economic model · meta-history + revenue tiers

money_predictions.title: No loans at Maze Bank
money_predictions.headline: No loans
money_predictions.line: Savings only; credit would undercut Shark Cards.
money_predictions.basis: No GTA has ever offered credit or interest on savings. A loan would reduce the urgency to buy Shark Cards.

money_predictions.title: Businesses tied to regions
money_predictions.headline: Region-locked
money_predictions.line: Clubs in Vice City, farms and smuggling in Leonida.
money_predictions.basis: Trailers show clubs and heists in Vice City, farms and smuggling in Leonida. Region-specific businesses would make earnings differ by region.

money_predictions.title: Jason and Lucia keep separate money
money_predictions.headline: Separate wallets
money_predictions.line: Own balances and businesses, as in GTA V.
money_predictions.basis: GTA V gave Michael, Franklin and Trevor separate balances. Two protagonists in two regions makes the same split likely.

money_predictions.title: Run businesses from your phone
money_predictions.headline: 24/7 mobile
money_predictions.basis: The multi-region diagram lists mobile-linked persistence, and GTA Online had the iFruit companion app. Rockstar has detailed the in-game smartphone but not a companion app.

money_predictions.title: Supply-and-sell passive income
money_predictions.headline: Trader cycle
money_predictions.line: Buy supplies, process, sell — like RDR Online's Trader.
money_predictions.basis: RDR Online's Trader role runs the same supply, process and sell loop as GTA Online's Bunker. Community sources report a goods-trading layer in Leonida.
